Name: (CP) Vanillaish Aideen (East Scarp)
Author: Hitme11
Description:
Portraits for your lovely old-fashion [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5787]East Scarp[/url] girl Aideen, drawing in vanilla-ish style. I wanted to do something different because I was out of ideas for genderbent mods (sorry). I will get to back to them now.

[color=#ff7700][b]VER 2.0.0: Cleaned up her hair and changed her face shape a little, also made her eyes less yellow.[/b][/color]

[b]DISCLAIMER:[/b] I copied [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11491]Nyapu's[/url] flower color palette and technique because I didn't know how to draw flower. Nyapu don't hate me please.

[b]INSTRUCTION:[/b]
- Installed [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5787]East Scarp[/url] and it dependency mods.
- Put [CP] Vanillaish Aideen (East Scarp) into your mod folder.
﻿- That's it.

[b]COMPATIBILITY:[/b]
﻿- As a portrait mod for Aideen, this doesn't compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10731]Thyrenoth's Aideen Seasonal Portraits[/url]﻿ or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12197]medicsun's Seasonal Outfits For Aideen[/url], so check out their mods to see what would suit you better.﻿

[b]PERMISSIONS: [/b]As always, I don't block any of my mod content from modification. Feel free to use any of my content in your mod or upload your modification version on Nexus, credit me if you want. 

[b]CREDITS[/b]: 
﻿Lermukat for the amazing[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5787] East Scarp[/url] mod and all of his wonderful NPCs, including Aideen.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10731] ﻿Thyrenoth's Aideen Seasonal Portraits[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7116]Vanilla Facelift (Portrait Mod)[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11491]Nyapu's Portraits[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12197]medicsun's Seasonal Outfits For Aideen[/url] for inspiration. Please check out their portraits mod, they're all well done and better than mine.
